details:
COSMOS ARCHITECT – Project Description

COSMOS ARCHITECT: Space Mission Systems Engineering & Flight Director Simulator is an interactive, web-based space mission simulation platform designed to help students understand how real space missions are planned, engineered, and controlled.

The project allows users to take the role of a space mission engineer and flight director. Users can select a planetary destination, assemble a spacecraft using different components, and observe how their engineering decisions affect the mission's performance.

It combines real aerospace concepts such as orbital mechanics, the rocket equation, Delta-V calculations, spacecraft propulsion, power management, radiation effects, and communication delays into an interactive simulation.

Key Features

  1. Destination Selection: Choose a space environment and understand its engineering requirements.
  2. 3D Spacecraft Assembly: Build a spacecraft by selecting components such as chassis, power systems, propulsion, communication systems, and scientific payloads.
  3. Orbital Simulation: Visualize spacecraft trajectories and Hohmann transfer orbits.
  4. Flight Director Console: Monitor velocity, fuel, power, science output, and mission status.
  5. Emergency Management: Respond to simulated events such as solar storms and trajectory deviations.
  6. Mission Debrief: Receive mission scores and understand how engineering decisions affected the final outcome.
  7. Interactive Audio and Visuals: Experience procedural sound effects and animated spacecraft feedback.

Technology Stack

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite
  • 3D Graphics: Three.js and WebGL
  • Styling: Tailwind CSS
  • Simulation: HTML5 Canvas
  • Audio: Web Audio API

Main Objective

The main objective of COSMOS ARCHITECT is to transform complex aerospace engineering concepts into an engaging, interactive learning experience. It helps users develop systems-thinking skills, understand engineering trade-offs, manage limited spacecraft resources, and make critical decisions during simulated space missions.

Short Description (for Hackathon Submission)

COSMOS ARCHITECT is a web-based space mission engineering and flight director simulator that allows users to design spacecraft, select planetary destinations, simulate orbital transfers, and manage unexpected mission challenges. By combining aerospace physics, 3D visualization, real-time telemetry, and interactive decision-making, it transforms theoretical space engineering concepts into a practical and engaging virtual mission experience.
